# Fixture provenance

These fixed excerpts are regression inputs. Their original line wrapping is intentional and is tested; they are not product copy.

- `three-men-ch1.md`: Jerome K. Jerome, *Three Men in a Boat (To Say Nothing of the Dog)* (1889), opening of chapter I. Source: [Project Gutenberg eBook 308](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/308), credited to David Price and Margaret Price. The Gutenberg header/footer and picture markers were removed when the fixture was created.
- `walden-economy.md`: Henry David Thoreau, *Walden* (1854), opening three paragraphs of “Economy”. Source: [Project Gutenberg eBook 205](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/205), credited to Judith Boss and David Widger. The Gutenberg header/footer were removed when the fixture was created.

The linked catalogue entries identify both literary works as public domain in the USA. These excerpts are attributed to their original authors; the crate's MIT notice does not imply Terraphim authored them.

`zed-plugin-fit.md` and `zed-plugin-fit-full.md` are existing Terraphim project requirements excerpts, retained unchanged as test inputs. The small domain/corpus notes and generated role/thesaurus JSON are Terraphim test fixtures. The literary fixture source and transformations were originally recorded in `docs/research/lab-heuristics.md` in this repository.
